title: Place in storage
purpose: Put a specimen that has no storage position, and has never been stored or is available again, into a free position.
summary: Put a specimen that is not in storage, and is not checked out, into a free position.

tasks.title: Store the specimen
steps: Choose the [[Box]] and type the [[Position]] label, for example A1. The help lists free positions.

tasks.title: Store a checked-out specimen
steps: Use [[Record check-in]] on the record instead. It also closes the time out of storage.

good_to_know: Only one specimen can occupy a position. It is rechecked when you save, so a position taken meanwhile is refused.
Free positions are not reserved for you.

sections.title: Who can use it and when
paragraphs: Admin, manager and technician can use this form; a viewer is refused.

When the action is not possible right now, the form opens with a Not available notice giving the reason, its fields are disabled and there is no submit button; Cancel returns to the record. The checks are repeated on the server when you save, so a form that opens is not a guarantee.

The top of the form repeats the specimen ID (a link back to the record), status including any active holds, amount on hand and location, so you can confirm you are acting on the right specimen. The location reads Checked out to the person and destination while checked out, Returned, in hand of the person who received it (with where it came back from) after a return from outside the repository, and Distributed: outside the repository while it is away in a shipment.

It is available only for an available specimen that is not checked out, not already in a position and not disposed. A checked-out specimen, or one in hand after a return, is stored with Record check-in; a stored one moves with Relocate. A distributed specimen (sent out of the repository in a shipment) is refused until its return is recorded.

items.label: Box
items.description: Active boxes, shown with their storage unit, rack path and number of free positions.

items.label: Position
items.description: The position label inside the box, such as A1; capitals do not matter. The help text lists up to 12 free positions (nothing is reserved). The position must exist, be free and not blocked, and is checked again under lock when you save, so someone else may take it first. A box without a label, or a label without a box, is refused.

items.label: Placed at
items.description: Required. Repository local time to the second; not in the future and not before the specimen's last recorded event.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, up to 2,000 characters. Kept in the history with the change. Starts as “Stored after processing”. Do not enter names, record numbers, birth dates, contact details or other text that could identify a donor.

sections.title: Saving and rules
paragraphs: Place in storage records a placement event with the position path at the time and occupies the position. Only one specimen can occupy a position; this is enforced by the database and rechecked when you save. Material with nothing on hand is not placed. Hidden revision numbers are captured when the form opens. If the specimen was changed by someone else meanwhile, the save is refused with “Specimen VP-… changed since you opened it. Reload it, check the current state and try again” (or, for storage changes, “The specimen's storage location changed since you opened this page… Reload it and try again”). Nothing is saved; reopen the form from the specimen record to pick up the current state before entering the action again.

Times are repository local time, entered to the second. A time cannot be in the future or before the specimen's latest recorded event (the message names that event's time). A time within the same second as that event is taken as that event's own time, so recording straight after another event keeps the order. The form starts at the current time.
